source.snippet: I am trying to upsert/create a record in Salesforce Sales Cloud directly from a CloudPage using AMPscript. I am using the CreateSObject (or UpdateSingleSalesforceObject) function to log a custom request record into a custom Salesforce Object (Service_Ticket__c). However, when I submit the CloudPage form, the process fails with a 500 error. Upon enabling debugging, the specific error returned from the Salesforce API call is: FIELD_INTEGRITY_EXCEPTION: field integrity exception: unknown (Required field is missing). [Second signal] My goal is to use a value calculated in Apex to pre-filter Knowledge articles in Prompt Builder. I created a custom retriever with a dynamic filter condition... I attempted to fill the Pre-filter field on the left with a name of an Apex class: {!$Apex:LEXAI_KnowledgeLanguageService} which [failed].

problem_statement: Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Sales Cloud developers repeatedly hit opaque runtime errors when integrating AMPscript with Sales Cloud objects and when wiring Apex logic into AI Prompt Builder retrievers — debugging requires deep cross-cloud expertise that most teams lack, and errors surface only at runtime with minimal actionable guidance.
target_segment: Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Sales Cloud developers at mid-to-large enterprises building customer-facing automations and AI-assisted support flows.
notes: Two independent Salesforce developer questions on the same day (2026-08-13 and 2026-08-14) about cross-cloud integration failures. Both involve enterprise Salesforce setups (Sales Cloud + Marketing Cloud + AI), implying salaried or consulting developers whose time is billed. Pain is reproducible runtime errors with no clear error messages. A diagnostic/debugging assistant or pre-flight validator for Salesforce cross-cloud integrations could command SaaS pricing in enterprise context. Buyer is the Salesforce admin/developer or their agency.
